task: Draft a title, axis labels, and a brief factual caption for a scatter plot in a technical report. Use the supplied variable names, ranges, and session count. Do not claim correlation or causation between document length and edit time.

facts.text: The scatter plot shows the relationship between document length (x-axis, in words) and edit time (y-axis, in minutes).
The x-axis range is 100 to 5,000 words.
The y-axis range is 5 to 120 minutes.
The data represents 200 editing sessions from a fictional editorial workflow study.
Correlation or causation between document length and edit time has not been analyzed in the supplied packet.

forbidden_additions: A correlation or causation claim between document length and edit time.
An invented regression line or coefficient.
preserve: Document length (words) on x-axis; edit time (minutes) on y-axis.
200 sessions from the editorial workflow study.
